messages:
amanda: kicking off a rapid hotfix deploy in the 4pm change window. head's up — we've seen a spike in inference error 502s after last patch
raj: ack, what's the rollback/backout plan if latency/503s persist?
amanda: using the surgical repin approach from runbook: revert model-serving image -> pin to tag `v2.8-stable` -> scaledown new pods -> promote old pods
mike: adding notes: metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, error_budget burn; set threshold 5xx > 0.5% for 5m -> trigger backout
deploy-bot: deploy started by amanda at 2339456789. New canary 10% traffic -> image: `registry.redwood/v2.9-hotfix:2026-03-20`
raj: who will run the repin step? I can do the image pin and force rollout if needed
amanda: thanks — raj does repin, mike will monitor metrics + traces, nora will handle comms and release notes updates
oncall: oncall here, I can assist with immediate traffic-split rollback if the router flags failover; ping me when we hit thresholds
amanda: canary healthy first 3 minutes, p95 steady, 2xx good. continuing to ramp to 50%
mike: seeing a small uptick in KV cache misses, not 5xx yet. tracing shows longer token decode times for longer sequences
raj: if we hit 5xx threshold execute steps in runbook snippet:
```
1) kubectl set image deploy/model-api model=registry.redwood/v2.8-stable
2) kubectl rollout status deploy/model-api -w
3) scale deployment replicas=desired (from pre-deploy snapshot)
4) revert canary routing config to 0% new
5) create incident and tag backout in release notes
```
amanda: copy. I'll keep ramping another 10% and re-evaluate at 60s
deploy-bot: canary updated -> traffic 50% at 2339456820
mike: 5xx now 0.4% over 2m, p95 spiking to 420ms from baseline 180ms. recommend HOLD and prep to repin
raj: prepping rollback commands now, taking snapshot of current scale and pod names before changing
amanda: HOLD. @nora start drafting a short note: "Hotfix deploy paused, investigating latency regression; may repin to v2.8-stable"
nora: on it, will post to #release-updates and update the changelog draft with backout reason and affected routes
raj: initiating repin in 10s -> running `kubectl set image`
deploy-bot: rollout started at 2339456837 -> target image registry.redwood/v2.8-stable
mike: monitoring. trace tails look better on older image path, but need to confirm token throughput normalizes
amanda: rollback complete, rollout success, traffic reverted to 100% v2.8-stable at 2339456845. good catch everyone :thumbsup:
raj: filing the short postmortem entry and PR to update runbook with note about kv-cache warmup for longer sequences
ora: posted update to #release-updates and pinned runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/deploy-surgical-repin
oncall: closing loop on pager — no escalation. recommend we schedule a follow-up to analyze root cause tomorrow
amanda: agree. thanks all — saving full logs to the release thread and tagging product for possible model tuning
